cohort: 16,254 women with singleton pregnancies attending for an ultrasound scan at 19-24 weeks as part of routine pregnancy care.
finding: Assessment of risk for pre-eclampsia (PE) at 19-24 weeks' gestation, using a combination of maternal factors, MAP, UtA-PI, PlGF, and sFlt-1, can effectively stratify pregnant women into high-, intermediate-, and low-risk groups, enabling targeted monitoring and improving detection rates for early PE.
followup_time: Up to delivery (with assessments through 36 weeks' gestation)
